title: Creation and Setup of hexmap R Package
text: Configured Leaflet ggplot2 autoplots (R/leaflet.R, R/leafletApp.R, R/watershed.R, R/habitat.R) use transparent fills (fillOpacity = 0 / fill = NA) drawn regions, subwatershed boundaries, hexagonal substrate meshes maintaining distinct border outlines click interactivity. Enhanced get_hucs_from_polygon(polygon_sf, max_hucs = 6) auto-scale HUC subwatershed granularity dynamically based extent user-drawn bounding polygon. Inspects 12-digit HUC string prefixes memory (HUC12 →\rightarrowHUC10 →\rightarrowHUC08 →\rightarrowHUC06 →\rightarrowHUC04) single HUC12 spatial AOI query, selecting finest level ≤max_hucs\le \text{max\_hucs} regions. Fetches parent geometries via single direct ID query (nhdplusTools::get_huc(id = target_ids, type = target_level)), eliminating trial--error WFS network overhead. Fixed NHDPlus two-digit type formatting ("huc08", "huc06", "huc04") implemented coarsest-level fallback scaling large regional polygons span 50–1200+ HUC12s, guaranteeing condensation small, readable count 4–6 sub-basins. Replaced degree diameter sliders indexed geometric scale slider (n_hex_idx, values: 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000, default: 100) R/hexmapApp.R. Dynamically computes cell diameter d=/(0.65×N)d = \sqrt{/ (0.65 \times N)} based region bounding box area AA, guaranteeing consistent grid cell density across small islands multi-state regional watersheds. Rendered hex grid subtle slate gray (#7F8C8D) positioned behind HUC boundaries Leaflet maps ggplot2 autoplots (R/leaflet.R, R/watershed.R, R/habitat.R). Added Include Hexagonal Grid Overlay checkbox (enable_hex) allowing users toggle hex mesh generation retaining watershed boundaries habitat overlays. Reorganized sidebar UI controls hexmapInput(), placing primary grid settings top moving selected HUCs multi-select list bottom. Updated Leaflet draw observers (input$clear_region, input$mapper_draw_start, input$mapper_draw_new_feature) purge previous drawn rubberband shapes (clearGroup("Drawn Region")) HUC shapes (clearGroup("huc_polygons")) clicking “Clear Region” starting new polygon draw operation. Disabled automatic point reverse-geocoding network calls map background taps (input$mapper_click), preventing unexpected latency panning zooming. Consolidated sidebar download options R/hexmapApp.R single Download Hexmap Topology (.rds) button (download_hexmap). Downloads single unified S3 spatial topology object containing layers (layer boundary sf, individual_hucs sf, hex_overlay sfc, hex_habitat_sf suitability sf, habitat_sf features sf, landmarks_sf POI points) rather separate files. title: User Guide: Interactive Hexagonal Mapping & Topology Data Structure
text: drawing regional polygon across large geographic area: - Small drawn regions (e.g. small county) return fine-grained HUC12 subwatersheds. - Large drawn regions (spanning multiple counties states) return 1000+ HUC12s, cluttering map slowing processing. - hexmap automatically scales HUC granularity using code-annealed prefix matching (HUC12 →\rightarrowHUC10 →\rightarrowHUC08 →\rightarrowHUC06 →\rightarrowHUC04) keep total number returned subwatersheds ≤Max Target HUCs\le \text{Max Target HUCs}.

title: User Guide: Interactive Hexagonal Mapping & Topology Data Structure
text: Use Max Target HUCs (Granularity) slider sidebar (default: 6, range: 3 15): - Lower values (3–5): Produces fewer, larger parent sub-basins (HUC08 HUC06). - Higher values (10–15): Allows fine-grained subwatersheds (HUC12 HUC10).

title: User Guide: Interactive Hexagonal Mapping & Topology Data Structure
code: topology_object (S3 class: habitat_hex_overlay / watershed_hex_overlay) ├── $layer            : sf / sfc polygon boundary (selected region / feature restriction) ├── $individual_hucs  : sf data frame of individual component subwatersheds ├── $hex_overlay      : sfc polygon geometry list of hexagonal grid cells (or NULL if disabled) ├── $hex_habitat_sf   : sf data frame of hex cells with habitat scores & types (or NULL if disabled) ├── $habitat_sf       : sf data frame of extracted OpenStreetMap habitat polygons ├── $landmarks_sf     : sf data frame of point sighting landmarks ├── $huc_id           : character vector of selected HUC ID(s) ├── $feature_name     : character string of applied feature restriction (or NULL) └── $hex_diameter     : numeric hexagon extent diameter in degrees (or NULL if disabled)

View overall S3 class and metadata class(topo) cat("HUC ID:", topo$huc_id, "\nFeature:", topo$feature_name, "\n")  # 2. Extract boundary polygon boundary_sf <- topo$layer  # 3. Extract individual subwatersheds hucs_sf <- topo$individual_hucs  # 4. Extract hexagonal substrate grid with suitability weights (if enabled) if (!is.null(topo$hex_habitat_sf)) {   hex_mesh_sf <- topo$hex_habitat_sf   head(hex_mesh_sf) }  # 5. Render static ggplot autoplot directly autoplot(topo)
